novelty_flags.label: thm:commitment-saddle
novelty_flags.one_line: The stated saddle and binding-weight certificate are a direct instance of Tommasi et al.’s general maximin-efficiency equivalence once baseline gain is declared the component criterion, so they cannot carry the field-tier novelty claim.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops minimax-variance controlled-experiment designs whose response structure determines the imbalance metric, including kernel allocation.
For a given conditional-mean class, the paper studies minimax-optimal two-arm randomization and shows that structured classes can require randomization beyond a single partition.

source_verification_receipts.version: Public preprint corresponding to the cited Statistics in Medicine article; publication full text was inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint computes relative efficiency as a variance ratio to a locally optimal design and maximizes its worst case over ICC scenarios, including a multiple-objective extension.

The paper states that its result covers any multi-objective problem expressible as minimum design efficiency and proves a maximin-efficiency design iff a Bayesian-optimal design for a probability distribution supported on binding criteria.
The paper characterizes efficiency-constrained and maximin optimal designs on a discrete design space and uses linear programming to verify optimality.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 565–568, abstract, introduction, Theorem 2.1 discussion, and Remark 2.4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves finite-sample minimax optimality of complete randomization under permutation invariance and describes that invariance as an idealization.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the generic saddle as the headline with a causal theorem that is not inherited from maximin-efficiency theory: for a specified, nontrivial menu family, derive a finite-n lower or upper bound on lambda-star in observable spectral quantities and prove its sharpness or a strict improvement over a named baseline.

Rewrite prop:gain-efficiency-nonrepresentability against RyanEssermanLi2023MaximinHTE’s exact relative-efficiency formula: state the embedding from its design problem into the response-geometry model, cite the equation and criterion in the proposition, and prove separation on that shared subproblem rather than against an internally coined eta-star.

Promote the asymptotic open question into a concrete theorem target by fixing a triangular kernel-menu class, a named compatibility modulus, and a claimed rate for 1-lambda_n-star; retain the direct-sum discrepancy construction as the attaining route and include a least-favorable menu route.

recommended_next_step: Return to Stage -1 revision: repair the dangling corollary reference, anchor the nonrepresentability theorem to an exact published comparator, and make a quantitative causal commitment-price frontier—not the generic saddle—the field-tier kernel.
